patterns: APPSC asks single-fact leader items: Andhra Bank founder (Pattabhi, asked twice 2019), 'Andhra Kesari' after Simon Go Back, Pingali served in Boer War.
Book -> author is a recurring shape (Pattabhi = official History of the Congress).
Title -> leader matching (Andhra Kesari, Andhra Ratna, Desoddharaka, Andhra Pitamaha) is the core AP-history trap area.
App is broader (Konda's Mahasabha posts, Sribagh signatories, autobiography parts); keep to direct, verifiable recall.
